answer.rationale: The low-cost vendor is the only stated path to the mandated 18% component-spend reduction, while the incumbent has refused repricing. Verify the prior record that onboarding was quick and invoicing accurate, then transition through a tightly guarded initial supply test rather than an unmitigated rollout. The line's 94% committed volume and lack of buffer create material delivery risk, so capacity, lead times, quality, and escalation coverage must be confirmed before expanding. Adding a second source may reduce concentration risk but could fail the cost mandate and cannot be pursued this cycle.
